title: pentacalia tingoensis
intro: Pentacalia tingoensis, commonly known as Tingo mint, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. As a medicinal plant, it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including relief from fever, cough, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Tingo mint include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. Further research is needed to fully understand the mechanisms behind the bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
